messages:
pagerduty-bot: P1 alert — inference-api: rolling deploy caused increased 5xx rate in us-west-2. Paging @ali (sre-oncall). See metrics: https://grafana/redwood/d/inference/rollout

ali (sre-oncall): On it. What changed in the rollout and when did it start?

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 1782504200 by jordan (devex). New manifest changed readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds 5 -> 3 and added a preStop hook. Rolling update strategy: 25% max surge.

ben (eng-runtime): Seeing crashloop on inference-encoder pods after new image. Logs show process exiting during shutdown sequence with SIGKILL ~5s after TERM. snippet: ```
2026-03-17T12:12:45Z INF startup complete
2026-03-17T12:12:50Z INF received SIGTERM
2026-03-17T12:12:55Z ERR oom or forced kill
```

chandra (eng-platform): HPA triggered scale-down during rollout. New manifest accidentally set minReplicas: 1. During drain the HPA dropped the stable replica count, causing capacity hole.

mari (support): Customers reporting 502/timeout spikes, some transactions retried. CS alerted top 5 accounts and opened support threads.

ali (sre-oncall): Action plan: 1) Pause rollout, 2) toggle feature flag off for encoder_v2, 3) scale up stable replicaset, 4) avoid draining nodes with in-flight traffic. Jordan, can you pause?

jordan (devex): Pausing now: ```kubectl rollout pause deployment/inference-api -n prod```

ben (eng-runtime): Toggling kill-switch: feature flag `encoder_v2` -> false (done). Confirmed flag evals are returning v1.14.2.

chandra (eng-platform): Scaling stable replica set while overriding HPA temporarily: ```kubectl scale deploy/inference-api-stable --replicas=6 -n prod``` — note: HPA minReplicas=1 conflict; we'll patch HPA after stabilization.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused successfully. Autoscaler has conflicting minReplicas; manual scale applied.

ali (sre-oncall): Any node drains in progress? Events show some pods stuck Terminating — preStop hang on new image.

ben (eng-runtime): Confirmed: preStop hook waits on unix socket that new binary doesn't create reliably. That is hanging shutdown and triggering forced kills. Short-term mitigation: rollback image to v1.14.2. We'll remove/change prestop in follow-up patch.

jordan (devex): Initiating rollback to v1.14.2: ```kubectl set image deployment/inference-api inference-api=registry.redwood/inference-api:v1.14.2 -n prod```

pagerduty-bot: Rollback initiated by jordan (devex) at 1782504520.

mari (support): Creating incident on status page: INC-2026-042. Drafting customer communication noting transient 12-minute degradation and retry behavior.

ali (sre-oncall): Monitoring metrics — 5xxs dropping, latency normalizing. Keep an eye on KV cache warmup and tail latencies.

chandra (eng-platform): I'll open a PR to fix HPA minReplicas to 3 and remove the prestop hook from the rollout manifest. Post-rollback we should run drain tests in staging.

jordan (devex): Rollback completed — new pods running v1.14.2 and passing readiness checks. 502 rate back to baseline. Leaving rollout paused until follow-up patch.

ben (eng-runtime): +1. Will own fix for prestop + add e2e that simulates drain.

ali (sre-oncall): Handoff: I'll stay oncall for the next 2 hours to watch for regressions. If we see repeated failures, escalate to SRE lead.

mari (support): Customer impact summary: ~12 min of elevated 5xxs affecting some high-throughput customers; retries mitigated most errors. Logged affected accounts and next steps for proactive outreach.

pagerduty-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2. Last update at 1782505200.
